slots.writingObjective: State as a fact about TextOS that it records which sources AI answers cite, dated, without lending competitors intent or cause.
One sentence for a search result: TextOS keeps a dated record of who AI answers cite and what competitors' public pages say, and never explains why.
Open on the reader's situation: an AI assistant recommends someone else for a question they should own, and the instinct is to guess why. Say the note is about keeping a record rather than a theory.
slots.buyerIntent: Why does AI cite them and not me?

slots.heading: How can I find out which competitors AI assistants cite instead of me?
slots.writingObjective: Answer directly: TextOS reads, question by question, which sources the engines cited in its own measurements, with dates; it records what is cited and what public pages say, without attributing intent or cause; it is not a copy of competitors' sites fed to a writer.
slots.buyerIntent: How can I find out which competitors AI assistants cite instead of me?

slots.heading: A record of who gets cited, question by question
slots.writingObjective: Explain the per-question view built from measurements already taken: who was cited, which sources the engines relied on, which surfaces, and how citations moved between comparable runs. Then explain the weekly summary: at most three facts that call for a decision since the previous comparable run.
slots.buyerIntent: What do I actually get to see?

slots.writingObjective: Caption the figure of this note in one or two factual sentences, grounded in the evidence it cites.

slots.heading: Not seen is not the same as absent
slots.writingObjective: Explain why an absence is never read as a zero: a run with no usable answer is unknown, an absence observed by TextOS is not an absence at the competitor and always carries its coverage, and a pattern always shows its denominator and what was not observed. Say what that protects a reader from.
slots.buyerIntent: Can I trust it when it says a competitor is not there?

slots.heading: Description, never a recipe or a motive
slots.writingObjective: Explain that TextOS describes and never lends intent or causality: page properties of cited and non-cited pages are compared with denominators and a minimum sample, descriptively and never as a recipe; co-occurrences after a change are never presented as causes; and the capability is not a copy of competitors' sites fed to a writer.
slots.buyerIntent: Will it tell me what to copy?

slots.heading: Who decides who your competitors are, and what stays switched off
slots.writingObjective: Explain that no competitor is hard-coded and linking a competitor to a site only comes from a declaration; that human feedback on facts reorders without hiding and stays within one organization; that past briefs are re-assessed without anything being closed or changed automatically; and that no third-party page is read until a governance decision is ratified and a legal opinion is given.

slots.heading: What to ask any tool that reports on competitors in AI answers
slots.writingObjective: Give the buyer a short list of questions to put to any vendor, one per sentence, drawn from the mechanisms this note describes. Recommendations only, no claim about TextOS.

slots.heading: Where to go next
slots.writingObjective: Point the reader to the related notes. No claim about TextOS.
